tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search processed notes in the user's Second Brain by keyword, category, or tag. Returns results in token-optimized TOON format.

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Retrieve full markdown content and metadata for a specific note.

tools.name: get_taxonomy_tree
tools.description: Inspect the user's active taxonomy folders, dynamic folder metrics, and canonical tag dictionary in TOON format.

tools.name: get_notebooklm_compendium
tools.description: Fetch the master Google NotebookLM Knowledge Base Markdown pack for the user's vault.

tools.name: create_topic_folder
tools.description: Dynamically create a new taxonomy folder in the user's vault under strict guardrail rules (Max 30 folders).

tools.name: export_processed_batch
tools.description: Export newly processed batch of notes (up to 1,000 notes) in token-optimized TOON format after payment.

tools.name: get_tenant_status
tools.description: Get workspace statistics and processing telemetry for the client session.
